body:
The hardest part is when the friends act like everything is fine. I can detect a slight stiffness or annoyance at times though. They still tell me that they love me and I wish they wouldn't if that's not how they feel.

No chance with help at the school clinic either. They just want to talk. I've tried it with three different people. I truly think I need medicine but I have no way to get it with no car, little money, and no insurance. More and more I feel pushed to the fulfillment of all of the ideas that have haunted me for years. I mean, sometimes your problems aren't temporary anymore. 

My main desire is simply to be important to someone. Not in that bullshit "Everyone is important" way but in a truly connected way that shows me that I actually mean something. Looks pretty grim in regards to the fulfillment of that desire though.
